ios.desc:
Introducing IPTV Pro: Your Ultimate Streaming Solution!

Unlock a world of endless entertainment possibilities with IPTV Pro. No video format is off-limits! Our versatile player supports a vast array of extensions, ensuring seamless playback every time.

Legal Notice:
At IPTV Pro, we prioritize legality and respect for intellectual property. Our app is designed for users to enjoy their personal content or legally sourced playlists. We do not provide any content from our app.

Features:

SMART IMPORT: Simply paste the link, and we'll handle the rest. Our intelligent import feature ensures compatibility with various formats, so you can start watching without any hassle.

CHROMECAST & AIRPLAY SUPPORT: Effortlessly cast your favorite content from your iPhone or iPad to your TV using Chromecast or AirPlay. Enjoy your shows on the big screen with ease.

PRIVACY IS PROTECTED: Your privacy is our priority. Rest assured, the contents of your playlist are never shared with our servers. Your playlist remains accessible only on your devices.

iCLOUD SYNC: Enjoy seamless continuity across your devices. Start watching a movie on your iPad and seamlessly continue on your iPhone, thanks to iCloud sync.

Upgrade to Premium for better experience:

UNLIMITED PLAYLISTS & AD-FREE Experience

RECORD: Capture live TV moments with a single tap and watch them later at your convenience.

Subscription:

Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription with a free trial period will automatically renew to a paid subscription. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of the selected plan. Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be managed by going to Account Settings after purchase. You can cancel your subscription or free trial in the iTunes settings at least 24-hours before the end of the free trial period. The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period and you will be downgraded to the free service.

Our Privacy & Terms: https://sites.google.com/view/gseiptvsmart/home

IMPORTANT NOTE:
IPTV Pro does not provide IPTV services such as subscriptions or streams. Users must contact their TV service provider for credentials and content access. This app is designed to play your own content quickly and efficiently.

IMPORTANT NOTE:

quotes.text:
Hello!
Last year I've been working on my indie project called IPTV - Streams. After some years in the field, I've tried to put everything I've got into my own app. It's an IPTV app, but it has an emphasis on let you watch your favorites content. So, you can add your playlists and start watching while everything will be synced through iCloud.
App Store Link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/iptv-streams/id1492179924
For more info: https://andremartingo.github.io/iptv-streams/
It should feel right at home on iOS, as I always stick to Apple's human interface guidelines for design and UX. My goal is to keep growing the app to really take advantage of Apple's platform. It has some other things I'm proud of as well that help it stand out:
Fully built on iCloud (or CloudKit for any developers reading). No account creation, syncs everywhere.
Share your playlist (also built on iCloud/CloudKit)
Aesthetic Design
We support m3u8, mp4, mkv, mpv, 3gp, ts and much more.
Context menu with quick actions
Dark Mode support
Search your entire cloud and local library.
Universal too, so one purchase gets you both iPhone and iPad support
and quite a bit more
I'd love any feedback or thoughts on it, it releases Thursday. My vision is to keep building it up and make it available on every single Apple platform (iOS, iPadOS, watchOS, tvOS and macOS). Thanks for checking it out!

Thanks!
quotes.title: After a one year, I’ve released my app IPTV – Streams
